note: Garment activity classes. Add factory-specific classes under 'labels' with kind 'task'; never remove UNKNOWN. A label needs visible evidence of the task itself (see docs/GARMENT_ACTIVITIES.md).

labels.name: SEWING
labels.description: Operating a sewing machine or performing sewing work: hands guiding fabric under the needle / presser foot, or hand stitching.
labels.evidence: Hands at the needle area moving fabric through, or a needle and thread in hand. Sitting at a machine alone is not enough.

labels.name: FABRIC_HANDLING
labels.description: Handling, arranging, folding or moving fabric or cut panels.
labels.evidence: Fabric visibly being manipulated (spread, stacked, folded, carried). Merely holding fabric while doing something else is not enough.

labels.name: CUTTING
labels.description: Cutting fabric by hand or operating cutting equipment.
labels.evidence: Scissors, a knife or a cutting machine moving through fabric.

labels.name: IRONING
labels.evidence: An iron or press moving over / closing on a garment.

labels.name: MATERIAL_PICKING
labels.description: Picking or collecting materials (bundles, trims, thread, accessories).
labels.evidence: Reaching into a bin, rack or trolley and taking items.

labels.name: MACHINE_OPERATION
labels.description: Operating a production machine other than a sewing machine (e.g. fusing, button, bartack, embroidery).
labels.evidence: Hands on the machine's controls or loading / unloading it while it works. Standing beside a machine is not enough.

labels.name: QUALITY_INSPECTION
labels.evidence: A garment held up, turned over and examined, measured or compared against a standard.

labels.name: PACKING
labels.description: Folding, bagging or packing finished garments.
labels.evidence: Finished garments being folded into shape, put into bags or cartons, or sealed.

labels.name: WALKING
labels.description: Walking or moving between work areas.
labels.evidence: Continuous steps from one place to another (about a second or more).

labels.name: STANDING
labels.description: Standing without a confidently recognised task.
labels.evidence: Upright and stationary, and no task above is clearly visible.

labels.name: SITTING
labels.description: Sitting without a confidently recognised task.
labels.evidence: Seated, and no task above is clearly visible. Sitting at a sewing machine is SITTING unless sewing is visible.

labels.name: UNKNOWN
labels.evidence: Use whenever the task can't be seen or is ambiguous. Always a valid answer.
